name: SparseLeap Rasterization
definition: The occupancy geometry is generated from a lazily constructed occupancy-histogram tree where each node has one of the occupancy classes: empty (if completely empty), non-empty (if non-empty), or unknown (if such information is not yet known).
summary: SparseLeap Rasterization efficiently skips empty space in large sparse volumes by using hardware-accelerated rasterization to generate per-pixel ray segment lists, avoiding GPU hierarchy traversal.
